files.title: File:Rattlesnake Creek Bridge S pier detail.JPG
files.author: Ammodramus
files.caption:
Base of south pier of Rattlesnake Creek Bridge; seen from the north.  In the background is the bridge's south abutment.
The bridge is northwest of Bancroft in Cuming County, Nebraska; it carries a minimum-maintenance segment of County Road 22 across the creek just north of Nebraska Highway 16.  The pinned Pratt half-hip pony truss bridge was built in 1903.  It is listed in the National Register of Historic Places.
